common.currentCredential: Current credential: {masked}. Leave blank to keep it.

aws.title: AWS configuration
aws.description: Configure the AWS account credentials used by this tenant.
aws.regionRule: Enter a valid AWS region such as ap-south-1.
aws.bucketRule: Enter a valid lowercase S3 bucket name.
aws.secretHidden: The stored secret cannot be viewed. Leave blank to keep it.
aws.encryptedText: Access and secret keys are encrypted before database storage and are never returned by the API.
aws.securityAdvice: Use an IAM user or role with only the permissions required by this tenant. Rotate credentials regularly and override the application encryption key in production.

ai.enterPrices: Enter the prices to see costs. Runs from now on will be priced.
ai.keyEncryptedText: The key is never returned by the API and is excluded from audit payloads.

openai.title: OpenAI configuration
openai.description: Configure the tenant API key and models used for extraction and speech-to-text.
openai.extractionModelHint: Used for structured extraction from text, PDFs and image/video preprocessing outputs.
openai.transcriptionModelHint: Used to convert uploaded or recorded audio into text.
openai.pricesHint: Optional. Copy the USD prices of the two models above from OpenAI's pricing page. Each run's cost is worked out with the prices saved at that moment; leave blank to record usage only.
openai.processingText: PDF pages and images can be passed to a vision-capable extraction model. Raw video should first be converted into selected frames and an audio transcript, then those outputs can be analyzed together.

claude.title: Claude configuration
claude.description: Configure the tenant Anthropic API key and the Claude model used to extract items from sales-lead photos and videos.
claude.requiredInitially: Required for initial configuration. Create one in the Claude Console (console.anthropic.com).
claude.extractionModelHint: Reads the photo or the video frames and returns the rooms, items, fragile pieces and boxes.
claude.effortHint: How long Claude thinks before answering. Higher effort counts busy rooms more carefully but takes longer and uses more output tokens.
claude.pricesHint: Filled with Anthropic's list prices when you pick a model; adjust them to your contract. Each run's cost is worked out with the prices saved at that moment. Speech-to-text is priced in Settings › OpenAI.
claude.processingText: Claude reads pictures, not video files. For a video, still frames are stored in S3 next to it and Claude receives short-lived signed links to them. Claude cannot listen to sound, so when OpenAI is also configured the narration is transcribed by OpenAI and given to Claude as text.

currency.title: System currency
currency.description: Configure the accounting currency for this workspace.
currency.accountingCurrencyHint: Base amounts, accounting reports and exchange rates use this currency. Its exchange rate is always 1.
currency.lockedTitle: Accounting currency is locked for this workspace
currency.lockedText: Financial records already exist. Changing their accounting currency requires a controlled migration of historical values. The transaction default below can still be changed.
currency.chooseFirstText: Changing the accounting currency requires a new exchange-rate schedule. Rates entered for a previous base are kept separately and are not reused. The accounting currency locks after the first financial record.
currency.defaultTransactionHint: Suggested for new entries when a customer or vendor has no separate currency preference.
currency.rateRequired: A valid exchange rate is required.
currency.exchangeRateHint: Default currency per transaction currency unit. Filled automatically for the transaction date.
currency.exchangeRateAria: Transaction to default currency exchange rate
currency.noDefaultRate: No default-currency rate for this date.
currency.noDefaultRateHint: Set a valid rate on Currency Exchange Rates to calculate the conversion.
currency.mastersHint: Configure the accounting base under Settings → System currency. Maintain currencies and the transaction default here. Enter dated rates on the separate Currency Exchange Rates page.
currency.ratesSaved: Exchange rates saved for all currencies
currency.periodTitle: Set rates for all active currencies for one period
currency.periodText: Choose inclusive start and end dates. Enter the system-currency value of one unit. The system currency remains 1. Previously recorded transactions retain their saved rates.
currency.endBeforeStart: End date must be on or after start date
currency.reviewText: Existing rates are copied as a starting point. Fill any empty rates. Saving the same start date updates that period; overlapping periods are rejected.
currency.enterRate: Enter the rate for this currency.
